task_evaluations.name: Polars DataFrame Operations
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to guide Polars data transformations
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I perform complex aggregations and joins with Polars?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide guidance on Polars aggregations, groupby operations, and efficient join patterns.

task_evaluations.name: DuckDB SQL Pipelines
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to build SQL-based pipelines with DuckDB
task_evaluations.prompt: Build a SQL pipeline with DuckDB that processes multiple CSV files and outputs aggregated results.
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide SQL patterns for reading CSV files, performing transformations, and writing results efficiently with DuckDB.

task_evaluations.name: PyArrow Interchange
task_evaluations.description: Tests understanding of PyArrow as interchange format
task_evaluations.prompt: When and how should I use PyArrow for data interchange between tools?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain PyArrow's role in zero-copy data interchange and integration with Polars, Pandas, and DuckDB.
